entities.name: Karrthus, Tyrant of Jund
entities.description: A massive hellkite native to Jund and king among dragonkind; he appears in Flight of the White Cat and can be summoned by Sarkhan Vol.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: The shard of Alara where Karrthus rules the dragons and goblins live.
